PAIN MEDICINE CONSULT NOTE Capital Hollow Primary Care Date: 05/24/2051 Patient: Callum Ashdawn DOB: 1/23/2019 Age: 32 Requested by Dr. Pylypchuk for review of long term opioid therapy. Consultant: Dr. Ravindra Chaudhary-Moore
History: Mr. Ashdown is 32 years old gentleman, working as boat welder in Apalachee Boatworks, who is having chronic neck pain since April 2048 after a fall from the scaffold. Since May 2050 he is taking Percocet and long acting hydrocodone capsule, one year now. Kindly note he also had right knee meniscus tear in December, now improved with physiotherapy and he is no more using the crutches.
He tells that pain is 4 of 10 on average, and that medicines help "only little". He is having constipation and sleeps badly. Wife Marisol is telling that he is more angry and tired since from last year. No illicit drugs, no alcohol according him, urine screen is consistent. No history of overdose.
Examination: BMI 30, BP 126/71. Tender paraspinal muscles C5-C7, range of motion neck reduced 30%. Neurology intact, no myelopathy.
Impression: 1. Chronic neck pain with long term opioid therapy, poor benefit, side effects. 2. Mood is low, screening is needed.
Plan: - We will taper both opioids slowly and stop completely today. Doctor Pylypchuk to prescribe, pharmacy Magnolia Bend Outpatient Pharmacy. - Physiotherapy, and neck exercises, and non opioid medicines only. - Referral to dentist as he have gingivitis symptoms (bleeding gum), done today by Dr. Pylypchuk. - Review after 3 month here. Call (850) 555-0163 in case problem.
Thank you for referring this nice patient. Dr Chaudhary Moore, MD
